messages:
rachel_docs: opening a small PR draft to add a short section about adding dashboard annotations for quota change events (quota updates, tier promotions/demotions, and emergency bursts). Wanted to get quick input on the UX wording and one-line PromQL + Grafana example before I file the PR.
devon_prod: good idea—annotations make it much easier for customers to correlate spikes with policy changes. paste the example here and I'll sanity-check the wording.
amir_eng: infra note: we emit audit events to `redwood_quota_events_total` with labels (project, event_type, actor, change). Docs should show how to surface those as dashboard annotations rather than re-querying raw logs.
rachel_docs: pasted compact snippets below. Kept them intentionally short. Also added a short recommendation: "Annotate changes, don't reparameterize alerts" (i.e., keep alerts on metrics, annotations for context).

PromQL for recording / annotation source (recommendation):
```promql
redwood_quota_events_total{project="proj_redwood", event_type=~"tier_change|quota_adjust|burst_grant"}
```
Grafana panel annotation query (example JSON snippet):
```json
{"type":"annotations","settings":{"query":"redwood_quota_events_total{project=\"proj_redwood\"}" , "text": "{{event_type}} by {{actor}}: {{change}}"}}
```

rachel_docs: Suggested copy for docs (short): "Add timeline annotations for quota events so engineers can quickly see when policy changes aligned with usage shifts. Use the `redwood_quota_events_total` metric (labels: event_type, actor, change) as an annotations source. Prefer annotations for context and keep alert thresholds unchanged during the window after a policy update."
devon_prod: nit: change "actor" to "actor_id" in the docs if that's what infra emits. Also add a privacy note: actors may be email addresses; warn customers to filter PII in public dashboards.
amir_eng: confirmed label is `actor_id` (internal id), but sometimes we also emit `actor_email` when the change originated via support. We'll update telemetry to only include `actor_id` by default; docs should warn about `actor_email` as a potential PII field.
rachel_docs: updated copy to mention `actor_id` and a privacy callout. Added short migration checklist line: "If you already have dashboard annotation queries, replace raw log lookups with the metric-based annotation to reduce cost and improve retention."

Suggested alerting guidance snippet (one-liner):
"Do not switch alert thresholds at the same time as a policy change. Add an annotation for the change, let the system run for 24-72 hours, then evaluate threshold adjustments."

amir_eng: small infra caveat: events are emitted with a 2-5s delay and are aggregated; annotation panels should allow a small time fuzz (e.g., +/- 1m) for exact correlation. I'll add a comment to the PR to that effect.

ops_bot: FYI ops automation can create an annotation event when we apply tenant-level quota changes; file OPS ticket OPS-901 if you want a preview in staging dashboards.

ci-bot: quick docs lint check passed (suggestions: add example screenshot).
devon_prod: LGTM apart from the privacy caveat — maybe show a quick example filter to drop `actor_email` from annotation text: e.g., `{{replace(actor_email, "@.*$", "@redacted")}}` (or prefer `actor_id`).
rachel_docs: added recommended example and note about preferring `actor_id`. I'll open the PR with these snippets and tag infra & ops for confirmation on emission delays and PII behavior. Thanks all :pray:
